label: Phu Quoc
short_description: Loyalty-program beach resorts on Phu Quoc island, at the northern Bai Dai coast and the Emerald Bay area in the south.
intro: Phu Quoc's hotels in this directory are beach resorts at opposite ends of Vietnam's largest island, in the Gulf of Thailand: the far northern tip around Bai Dai and Ganh Dau, beside the VinWonders and Grand World complex; and the Emerald Bay area near An Thoi in the south, by the island's sunset coast and cable car. Both are a drive from Phu Quoc International Airport (PQC) in the island's center, and suit self-contained beach-and-resort stays rather than city travel.
